source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.4 with the thumb-rule boxes and the Quick Quiz (PDF 9-11).

blocks.text: Kisi paimaish ke jin hindson (digits) par hamein maqool had tak yaqeen ho, unhen significant figures kehte hain. Yeh dar asal us instrument ko zahir karte hain jis se paimaish ki gayi. Calculator se hisab karein to jawab mein decimal ke baad bohat se hindse aa jate hain. Yeh faltu hindse doosre shakhs ko dhoka de sakte hain ke yeh sab durust hain. Is liye jawab ko significant figures ki sahi tadaad tak round off kiya jata hai. Iske liye reading likhte waqt instrument ki uncertainty ya least count ko yaad rakhein, aur hisab ka jawab bhi significant figures ki sahi tadaad tak likhein. Behtar hai ke jawab scientific notation mein likha jaye taake significant figures ki tadaad mein koi shak na rahe.
Misal: ek hi cheez ko do mukhtalif balances se tolna:

Aam taur par ± 0.001 g ya ± 0.1 g nahi likha jata; samjha jata hai ke likhe gaye adad ke aakhri hindse mein kam az kam 1 unit ki uncertainty hai. Jitne hindse likhe gaye hain sab significant figures hain: yani durust maloom hindse aur pehla andaza (doubtful) hindsa. Significant figures ka sahi istemal hamari paimaish ki uncertainty ko theek zahir karta hai. Maslan scientists foran samajh jate hain ke 3.145 g wali reading 3.1 g se zyada durust hai, kyunke woh behtar ya zyada precise instrument se li gayi. Jaise jaise instruments aur techniques behtar hoti hain, jawab mein zyada significant figures aate hain aur tajurbe (experiment) ki accuracy barhti hai.

blocks.alt: Faasla (m) ka khara scale, upar 10⁻²⁰ se neeche 10³⁰ tak. Saath: nucleus ka qutr (diameter), atom ka qutr, insan ka qad, Zameen ka qutr, Suraj tak faasla, qareeb tareen sitare tak faasla, Milky Way ka qutr aur qareeb tareen galaxy tak faasla.
blocks.caption: Kuch faslon ka order of magnitude (For Your Information; kitab ke chart ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yeh scale bhi 10 ki powers mein hai: har bara nishan pichhle se 10¹⁰ guna bara faasla hai. Atom taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m, insaan taqreeban 1 m, Zameen ka diameter taqreeban 10⁷ m aur Suraj tak faasla taqreeban 1.5 × 10¹¹ m hai.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Kitab ka chart qareeb tareen galaxy ka faasla taqreeban 10²⁸ m ke paas dikhata hai. Qareeb tareen bari galaxy (Andromeda) asal mein taqreeban 2 × 10²² m door hai, is liye upar ke chart mein use Milky Way ke diameter (taqreeban 10²¹ m) ke foran baad rakha gaya hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Significant figures ke saath kaam
(i) Significant hindse ginna

items: Sab hindse 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 significant hain. Zero (sifr) significant ho bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi; zero ke liye yeh qawaid hain:
Do significant hindson ke darmiyan wala zero significant hai (maslan 205 mein 0).
Significant hindson ke baen (left) wale zero significant nahi: 0.00467 ya 02.59 mein koi zero significant nahi.

Significant hindse ke daen (right) wale zero significant ho bhi sakte hain aur nahi bhi. Decimal wale adad mein daen ke zero significant hain: 3.570 aur 7.4000 ke sab zero significant hain. Magar 8,000 kg jaise poore adad (integer) mein zero kitne significant hain, yeh instrument ki precision batati hai: least count 1 kg ho to chaar significant figures, 8.000 × 10³ kg; least count 10 kg ho to teen, 8.00 × 10³ kg, waghaira.
Scientific notation mein 10 ki power ke ilawa sab hindse significant hain: 8.70 × 10⁴ kg mein teen significant figures hain.

blocks.text: (ii) Zarb (multiply) ya taqseem (divide)
Zarb ya taqseem ke jawab mein utne hi significant figures rakhein jitne sab se kam durust factor (yani sab se kam significant figures wale factor) mein hain. Misal: calculator yeh hisab yun deta hai:

Kitab calculator ka jawab 1.45768982 × 10³ chhapti hai. Sahi jawab 1.45708982 × 10³ (yani 1457.09) hai. Teen significant figures tak round karne par dono 1.46 × 10³ hi bante hain, is liye aakhri jawab sahi hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Aakhri jawab ke liye: jama/tafreeq (addition/subtraction) mein ek jaisi precision (decimal places); zarb/taqseem mein ek jaisi accuracy (significant figures ki ek jaisi tadaad).
blocks.title: Remember Thumb Rule (Yaad rakhein)

blocks.text: Upar ke hisab mein sab se kam durust factor 3.64 × 10⁴ hai, jis mein teen significant figures hain; is liye jawab sirf teen significant figures tak likha jaye. Baqi hindse ghair-aham hain aur hata diye jayen. Hindse hatate waqt aakhri rakhe jane wale hindse ko in qawaid se round off karte hain:

items: Agar hataya jane wala pehla hindsa 5 se kam ho to aakhri rakha gaya hindsa waisa hi rehta hai.
Agar hataya jane wala pehla hindsa 5 se zyada ho to rakhe jane wale hindse mein 1 barha dein.

Agar hataya jane wala hindsa 5 ho to pichhla (rakha jane wala) hindsa taaq (odd) ho to 1 barha dein, juft (even) ho to waisa hi rehne dein. Neeche ke adad teen significant figures tak round kiye gaye hain; hindse ek ek kar ke hataye gaye hain.

blocks.text: 56.8546 mein hindse ek ek kar ke hatayein: 56.8546 → 56.855 → 56.86 → 56.9. 73.650 mein 6 juft hai, is liye 73.6; 64.350 mein 3 taaq hai, is liye 64.4.
blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein

blocks.text: Is qaide se hisse (ii) ke hisab ka sahi jawab 1.46 × 10³ hai.

Bohat si readings ki ausat (average) qeemat ke liye: uncertainty = ausat qeemat se mean deviation. Periodic uncertainty: timing device (stopwatch) ke least count ko oscillations ki tadaad se taqseem karein.
blocks.title: Thumb Rule for Uncertainty

blocks.text: (iii) Jama (add) ya tafreeq (subtract)

Jawab mein decimal places utne hi rakhein jitne jama ya tafreeq hone wali quantities mein se sab se kam decimal places wali quantity mein hain. Yahan significant figures ki tadaad nahi, decimal ki jagah dekhi jati hai. Misal: metres mein di gayi yeh quantities jama karni hain:
Pehli soorat (i) mein 72.1 ke decimal places sab se kam (ek) hain, is liye jawab 75.5 m. Doosri soorat (ii) mein 4.10 ke decimal places sab se kam (do) hain, is liye jawab 8.13 m.
Quick Quiz

blocks.prompt: 1. 0.0054 m, 0.03030 m, 40.0 m, 0.5 m aur 8.20 × 10⁷ m mein significant figures kitne hain?
blocks.explanation: 0.0054 m: do (shuru ke zero nahi ginte); 0.03030 m: chaar (3, darmiyan ka 0, 3, aakhri 0); 40.0 m: teen; 0.5 m: ek; 8.20 × 10⁷ m: teen.
Jama 2692.12 kg banti hai. Sab se kam decimal places 2602 kg mein hain (koi decimal place nahi), is liye jawab 2692 kg.
Farq 1.14 kg hai. 2.4 kg mein ek decimal place hai, is liye jawab 1.1 kg.
Hisab 1.674 × 10⁴ m deta hai. 3.6 mein sirf do significant figures hain, is liye jawab 1.7 × 10⁴ m.

blocks.text: Significant figures ki hadood (limitations)

Significant figures uncertainty ke sirf ek zariye ko dikhate hain: scale parhne ki uncertainty. Asal tajurbe mein uncertainty kai wajah se aati hai, jaise apni ghalti (personal error) aur kabhi chhupi hui systematic ghaltiyan. Scale jitni ijazat de us se behtar reading nahi li ja sakti, magar kul uncertainty significant figures ke andaze se kahin zyada bhi ho sakti hai.

blocks.caption: Thumb rules ek nazar mein
rows: ek jaisi precision (sab se kam decimal places)
ek jaisi accuracy (sab se kam significant figures)

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Significant figures = durust maloom hindse + pehla andaza hindsa; yeh instrument ki precision dikhate hain (3.145 g bamuqabla 3.1 g).
Zero ke qawaid: darmiyan wala significant; shuru wale nahi; decimal ke aakhir wale significant; poore adad mein least count se tay (8.000 × 10³ kg).
Zarb/taqseem: sab se kam significant figures (1.46 × 10³). Jama/tafreeq: sab se kam decimal places (75.5 m, 8.13 m). Rounding: 5 se kam → waisa hi; 5 se zyada → 1 barhao; bilkul 5 → juft ki taraf.
